snippet.title: Psalm 67 (Let the People Sing)
snippet.description:
'Psalm 67' is the 9th and final addition to the Jubilee Church the 'Psalms of Summer' worship collective!

These worship songs accompany our 'Psalms of Summer' sermon series. Each song is based on one of the books of Psalms. As David wrote songs to express his love for God and at times, his need for rescue and forgiveness, we also express our need for Him in our lives and we rejoice over what He has done for us!!!

We are reminded as we worship that we serve a God who deserves our highest praise. As we turn away from our sin, we turn to the One who saves!

Lyrics

Come all who thirst for Him
Come and drink your fill 
God’s in this place
Search while He can be found
Seek the One who saves
He is the Lord

Let the people sing His praise
Every heart give endless thanks
For the Lord our God is good to all He's made
Break the silence with a song
Til the whole earth sings along
For the Lord our God deserves the highest praise

Turn from Your sins and trust
In the One who died
And rose again
Call on Him while He's near
Then tell the world 
He is the Lord

Let all of the nations praise Him
Let the earth be glad and sing
Songs of joy and hope  
‘Til all come worship Him
